h1: Custom Infant Blankets for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom infant blankets in bulk for your brand. Soft, safe, and perfect for baby gifts. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Infant blankets require special attention to fabric softness and safety. Our custom infant blankets are made from materials like the Cozy Fleece Blanket and Sherpa Blanket, which are gentle on newborn skin. Perfect for hospitals, parenting programs, or corporate baby gifts, these blankets offer a plush feel without loose threads or harsh dyes. Choose from sizes suitable for cribs or strollers and add your logo via screen printing or embroidery for a soft, lasting impression.
heroAltText: Stack of soft custom infant blankets in pastel colors, perfect for baby gifts and branding.
